W09

Global academic search

/app/search
Roles: student, instructor, taScope: requiredPriority: coreLegacy: P45

Search the academic material the active user can open. Results retain their course, term and type; inaccessible records are absent from titles, counts and suggestions.

Keep historyClear queries
Permissions
  • Apply permissions before snippets, totals, facets and suggestions.
  • A staff query cannot retain staff results after switching to learner context.
  • Private calendar appointments are excluded from shared academic search.
Responsive
  • Filters precede results on narrow screens; result source text wraps.
  • Back restores query, filters, result position and focused link.
Accessibility
  • Search shortcut does not activate inside text editing controls.
  • Results are headed lists; counts and errors use a polite status region.
Data
  • Permitted content index fixture; result type, course, term and canonical link.
  • Current query/filter URL state and optional personal recent queries.
Acceptance checks (3)
  • Searching an exact hidden lesson title reveals no match or count hint.
  • Back from an assignment restores selected search filters.
  • A failed search shows retry and preserves the query instead of a false empty result.
Notes
  • PROPOSED academic web route template for HTML-first handoff; legacy IDs show lineage, not replacement or changed acceptance.
